Who is Doppel Master?

The is a character in . He is the master of the in , who activates the and the lobby's so that may enter the in their company.

When first enters the , the welcomes him and explains the purpose of the . It is the 's duty to awaken the and bind them to 's soul whenever he wishes to venture out into the . To do this, he chants a string of magical words that will awaken the and open the to permit entry. After doing this for the first time, he will explain the use of . If exits and returns to the lobby, he will have to speak with the again to reawaken the .
